summary.current_state: Single-module Android sample app (View/Fragment/XML UI, Hilt DI, Retrofit/OkHttp REST client) that consumes the Telnyx Android Video SDK AAR for WebRTC meeting behavior. One god ViewModel, LiveData state, no repository/use-case layer, no Compose, and no KMP source sets.
summary.test_inheritance: Instrumentation profile pinned in tests.yml: Pixel 2, API 29, portrait, en

modules.name: :app
facts: settings.gradle declares rootProject.name = 'Telnyx Meet' and a single included module ':app'.
app/build.gradle applies com.android.application, kotlin-android, kotlin-kapt, dagger.hilt.android.plugin, and androidx.navigation.safeargs; viewBinding is enabled.
The Telnyx Android Video SDK is consumed as 'com.github.team-telnyx:telnyx-meet-android-sdk:0.3.1@aar' from JitPack (app/build.gradle).
Third-party stack: Retrofit 2.9 + Gson, OkHttp 4.9, coroutines 1.4.2, Hilt 2.48 (kapt), CameraX, Dexter 6.2.2, Timber, Bugsnag (versions.gradle, app/build.gradle).

modules.name: build-tooling

The Kotlin Gradle plugin is declared twice with conflicting versions: ext.kotlin_version = '1.8.22' in build.gradle vs versions.kotlin = '1.5.10' in versions.gradle; both are added to the buildscript classpath.
ktlint is applied to all projects; kover 0.5.0 is applied; detekt 1.20.0 is on the classpath but not applied (build.gradle).
Repositories include jcenter() and mavenLocal() (build.gradle); jcenter is end-of-life and unstable for the KMP migration.

CI today: Qodana static scan (.github/workflows/code_quality.yml) and Firebase Test Lab APK flow that writes local.properties from a secret (.github/workflows/firebase.yml).

Data layer. RoomService.kt (Retrofit interface) plus data/model, data/model/request, data/model/response DTOs (Gson plain data classes: TokenInfo, RefreshTokenInfo, RoomDetails, RoomListMetadata, Create*/Refresh* request/response).

Hilt wiring: NetworkModule.kt (Retrofit/OkHttp/auth header), AppModule.kt (Context, Resources, Gson, SharedPreferences), FragmentFactoryModule.kt + FragmentKey.kt (fragment multi-binding), ApiKey.kt and BaseUrl.kt qualifiers.
Navigator.kt wraps androidx.navigation.NavController behind a Hilt singleton (UI-owned navigation handle).

All screens: 2 activities and 6 fragments + RoomsViewModel; subpackages ui/adapters (4 RecyclerView adapters), ui/factory (DefaultFragmentFactory.kt, DefaultFragmentFactoryEntryPoint.kt), ui/models (4 UI data classes), ui/utilities (KeyboardExtensions.kt, Utils.kt incl. calculateTokenExpireTime).

A vendored copy of an SDK class declared under the SDK package com.telnyx.video.sdk.ui.adapters inside app sources; duplicates SDK behavior and complicates boundary hygiene (candidate for deletion during migration).

15 XML layouts (res/layout), single menu (res/menu/room_menu.xml), navigation graph (res/navigation/navigation_main.xml), 34 strings (res/values/strings.xml), themes/colors, 35 drawable files (vectors and shapes).

Espresso suite ManageRoomDetailsActivityTest.kt (launch, room create, media toggles, stats dialog, chat, participants, name validation) with testhelpers/BaseUITest.kt, BaseTestInstrumentation.kt, JUnitTree.kt, SystemUIDemoModeHelper.kt, SystemUIDemoModeRule.kt, TestConstants.kt.

screens.role: Single-activity host; injects DefaultFragmentFactory via Hilt EntryPointAccessors, hosts NavHostFragment, wires Navigator to NavController, starts Bugsnag unless IS_APP_TESTING.

Participant name + room UUID entry (prefilled from BuildConfig.DEFAULT_ROOM), local camera preview via CameraX (ProcessCameraProvider/Preview/CameraSelector), permission gate via RoomsViewModel.checkPermissions.
Paged room list (RoomAdapter, infinite scroll calling getMoreRooms), swipe-to-delete with undo snackbar (deleteRoom on dismiss), name validation.
Room name entry, room creation, token creation, token display, connect, and forward to RoomFragment with safe-args (roomId, roomName, refreshToken, refreshTime).

1159-line meeting screen: participant tile grid (ParticipantTileAdapter + WrapGridLayoutManager), WebRTC SurfaceViewRenderer sinks, view modes (full grid / main share / full screen), menu controls (camera, mic, flip, blur, virtual background, audio output, network quality, report issue, chat, participants), stats polling loop, token-refresh timer, share-view orchestration.
Text chat: MessageListAdapter (self/remote/admin rows), recipient multi-select dialog, send path through RoomsViewModel.sendTextRoomMessage; history cached in VM memory and restored on destroy.
Read-only participants list (ParticipantsAdapter) observing join/leave/speak/stream-change events.
Landscape fullscreen rendering of a remote 'presentation' stream onto SurfaceViewRenderer; full-screen system-UI enforcer coroutine; navigates back when sharing stops.

facts: Destinations: joinRoomFragment (start), roomListFragment, roomCreateFragment, roomFragment, roomParticipantsFragment, roomChatFragment, sharingFullScreenFragment.
Safe-args actions carry participantName, roomId, roomName, refreshToken, refreshTime between destinations.

ui_kit.facts: XML ViewBinding + RecyclerView adapters + Material components; zero Compose usage; BaseFragment<FRAGMENT: ViewBinding> shares inflate/destroy logic.

facts: RoomsViewModel (@HiltViewModel) is the only ViewModel and a god object: it issues Retrofit enqueue calls, constructs and stores the SDK Room object ('lateinit var room: Room'), requests Android permissions via Dexter, builds an Android audio-output AlertDialog, and keeps chat history in memory.
All durable UI state is LiveData (MutableLiveData); one-off events use the SDK's com.telnyx.video.sdk.Event wrapper consumed via getContentIfNotHandled (RoomsViewModel lines 63-114).
The SDK Room exposes LiveData observables (connection status, participants, state changes, chat delivery), so the ViewModel re-exposes SDK LiveData directly; no StateFlow exists anywhere.

Unstructured concurrency: RoomFragment.startCounter, checkInitialMediaStatus, and startStatsJob each create CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Main/Default).launch directly (RoomFragment lines 176-189, 505, 528, 844); SharingFullScreenFragment runs an unmanaged 4-second full-screen-enforcer loop. None are lifecycle-scoped; BaseViewModel is empty.
Token refresh scheduling lives in the fragment (mRefreshTimer computed by ui/utilities/Utils.kt calculateTokenExpireTime at 90% of remaining validity), not in the ViewModel or domain layer.
No repository, use case, mapper, or persistence layer exists; AppModule provides SharedPreferences (di/AppModule.kt) but no production code consumes it.

RoomService defines 5 Retrofit endpoints returning retrofit2.Call: GET rooms (paged), POST rooms, DELETE rooms/{room_id}, POST rooms/{room_id}/actions/generate_join_client_token, POST rooms/{room_id}/actions/refresh_client_token.

NetworkModule provides base URL https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ (also re-built with HttpUrl.Builder inside providesRoomService), a BODY-level OkHttp logging interceptor, an Authorization header injected from BuildConfig.API_KEY, and 100s connect/read timeouts.

BuildConfig.API_KEY and BuildConfig.DEFAULT_ROOM are injected from local.properties by app/build.gradle buildTypes (API_KEY also becomes a resValue); the Gradle build throws GradleException if local.properties is unreadable.

Mission-relevant violation (future gate): production async is Retrofit Callback + LiveData, which mission-brief.json acceptance criteria forbid in migrated shared code; target is suspend/Flow with Ktor replacing Retrofit/Gson/OkHttp.
The same REST surface is the seam for Ktor in WP-2; ktor 1.6.0 already appears as a test-only dependency (versions.gradle).

shared_kmp_seams.name: REST API surface and DTOs
shared_kmp_seams.notes: Retrofit interface + Gson POJOs are platform-free logic (network calls, JSON models). Port to Ktor client with kotlinx.serialization and suspend functions; keep endpoint and payload shape identical to preserve parity.

shared_kmp_seams.name: Token lifecycle and refresh scheduling
shared_kmp_seams.notes: createTokenForRoom/refreshClientToken API flow plus the 90%-expiry timer math (calculateTokenExpireTime) and the delay-based restart loop are platform-independent; only the timer's execution scope is platform-owned.

shared_kmp_seams.name: Meeting engine contract (capability-aware)
shared_kmp_seams.notes: Today the UI calls the Android-only Room SDK directly. Extract one interface covering connect/disconnect, publish/update stream, subscribe/unsubscribe, participants, chat send/receive, active speaker, network stats, and a capability state per feature; both platform adapters implement it (see P-seams).

shared_kmp_seams.name: Presentation state and one-off effects
shared_kmp_seams.notes: Replace LiveData + SDK Event with StateFlow UI state and SharedFlow/channel effects with explicit buffering and lifecycle cancellation; the empty BaseViewModel and god ViewModel split into per-screen presenters.

shared_kmp_seams.name: UI models
shared_kmp_seams.notes: MessageUI, SelectedParticipant, StatsParticipant, and the StreamStats sealed hierarchy (Local/Remote Audio/Video stats) are pure Kotlin and belong in commonMain once the SDK types they wrap (Message, Participant) are mapped behind adapters.

shared_kmp_seams.name: Navigation route model
shared_kmp_seams.notes: Define destination routes and argument types (participantName, roomId, roomName, refreshToken, refreshTime) once; Android NavHost and iOS navigation consume the shared route model.

shared_kmp_seams.name: Room list pagination
shared_kmp_seams.notes: mTotalPages/mLastRetrievedPage/getMoreRooms plus the scroll-threshold trigger are pure logic; only the scroll event source is platform UI.

shared_kmp_seams.name: String resources
shared_kmp_seams.notes: 34 string resources migrate to Compose Multiplatform resources so shared screens render the same copy on both platforms.

android.facts: com.github.team-telnyx:telnyx-meet-android-sdk:0.3.1@aar supplies Room, PublishConfigHelper, TelnyxVideoProcessing, AudioDevice, Event, State/Status and the WebSocket stack; Room is constructed with an Android Context in RoomsViewModel.createTokenForRoom (lines 146-152), which must not leak into shared code.
org.webrtc.SurfaceViewRenderer and VideoTrack sinks render self/participant/presentation streams; lifecycle release is manual in onDestroyView/detach paths.
Local publish capture via PublishConfigHelper.createVideoTrack (front camera, 256x256@30) with start/stop/restart-on-resume semantics; pre-join preview uses CameraX ProcessCameraProvider.
PublishConfigHelper.createAudioTrack + updateStream toggling; mic/camera initial states carried through RoomsViewModel MediaOnStart flags.
AudioDevice.PHONE_EARPIECE / BLUETOOTH / LOUDSPEAKER switched via room.setAudioOutputDevice; a device-selection AlertDialog is built inside the ViewModel (UI leak to fix in WP-7).

Dexter runtime flow (RECORD_AUDIO, CAMERA, READ_MEDIA_* on Tiramisu+, storage on older) gated through permissionRequest LiveData; manifest declares INTERNET, CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, media/storage permissions.
TelnyxVideoProcessing.applyBackgroundBlur / applyVirtualBackground('clouds.jpeg'); no iOS equivalent is assumed (capability gap, see mission excluded scope).

Bugsnag (App lifecycle, issue-report dialog with SDK state attachment); manifest carries a com.bugsnag.android.API_KEY meta-data value that must not be reproduced in evidence; treat as a secret-hygiene finding.
getWebRTCStatsForStream(RTCStatsCollectorCallback) polled every 2s per selected stream; enable/disableNetworkMetricsReport per participant list; parse into Local/Remote Audio/Video stats models.

ios.facts: Mission scope requires an iOS TelnyxVideoSdk adapter through supported Objective-C/CocoaPods interop; no iOS code exists at head, so every iOS seam below is created fresh by WP-5 and must be verified against the real iOS SDK before claiming parity.
iOS video rendering replaces SurfaceViewRenderer (platform-agnostic video-frame sink abstraction at the contract boundary; iOS attaches its native view/Metal layer).
iOS capture session (AVFoundation) behind the same contract; permission prompts are iOS system dialogs (Info.plist usage descriptions) rather than Dexter.
AVAudioSession category/mode and output-port selection map to the shared audio-routing command; device choices (receiver/speaker/bluetooth) are iOS-specific values.
UIApplication lifecycle states and scene activation must drive connect/disconnect and capture restart semantics equivalent to Android's onStop/onSaveInstanceState behavior in RoomFragment.

Blur/virtual background and any screen-share or stats features lacking iOS SDK parity must be published as explicitly unavailable capabilities with honest UI, never simulated (mission excluded scope: 'Inventing unsupported iOS SDK capabilities').

credential_hygiene_findings.finding: Tracked in git despite the .gitignore entry; loaded by app/build.gradle buildTypes to inject the API key and default room into BuildConfig and resValue. Values must not be reproduced anywhere in this report or evidence; replacement belongs to WP-8.
Tracked file loaded by build.gradle for repository credential configuration (build.gradle lines 33-34). Same non-reproduction rule applies; untracking belongs to WP-8.
Contains a Bugsnag API key meta-data value inline; treat as a secret during hygiene work (WP-8) and never echo it into evidence.
Setup instructions direct developers to paste an API key into di/NetworkModule.kt; replace with environment/local configuration documentation in WP-8.

risks.detail: benchmark/kmp-fast-vm-test/README.md records that the legacy build fails before tests because historical WebRTC/libyuv artifacts cannot be resolved; the SDK AAR transitively surfaces org.webrtc types used across app code (RoomFragment, SharingFullScreenFragment, ParticipantTileAdapter). WP-1 must pick resolvable replacements or SDK-managed binaries and prove it in the dependency-resolution gate.
Kotlin plugin is declared at 1.8.22 (build.gradle) and 1.5.10 (versions.gradle) simultaneously; Gradle wrapper 7.2 and AGP 7.1.3 are too old for KMP/CMP toolchains.

The Room SDK exposes LiveData, needs an Android Context, and its Event/Participant/Message/Stream types appear throughout UI code; every one of those references must be funneled behind the WP-3 contract or the shared module will not compile on iOS.

RoomsViewModel mixes networking, SDK lifecycle, permissions, dialogs, and chat history; RoomFragment handles layout math, menu actions, stats parsing, and timers. Decomposition must preserve observable behaviors that Espresso covers in app/src/androidTest/java/com/telnyx/meet/ui/ManageRoomDetailsActivityTest.kt.

Disconnect-triggered navigation relies on Android back-stack behaviors (roomFragmentToJoinRoomFragment with popUpToInclusive), and SDK Event consumption uses getContentIfNotHandled; the shared effect/route design must reproduce these semantics or document intentional changes.

open_questions: Confirm the exact resolvable WebRTC/Metal replacement strategy for Android and the iOS SDK version/target before WP-1 finalizes the version catalog (owner: WP-1).
Verify iOS SDK parity per capability (blur, virtual background, screen share, stats) with the real Telnyx iOS SDK before publishing the capability matrix (owner: WP-5).
Decide whether the legacy :app module is retained as a parity reference during migration or removed once composeApp reaches feature parity (owner: WP-8 documentation).
